title: Auto-Negotiation
description: Understand how auto-negotiation works and how to configure speed/duplex manually.
scenario: Understand how auto-negotiation works and how to configure speed/duplex manually.

concepts.title: Auto-Negotiation
concepts.body: Auto-negotiation is an IEEE 802.3z standard. Devices exchange capabilities and choose the highest common speed/duplex.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# speed auto
SW1(config-if)# duplex auto

concepts.title: Manual Configuration
concepts.body: If you set speed manually, duplex must also be set manually. Setting only speed disables auto-negotiation.

concepts.title: Best Practice
concepts.body: Leave auto-negotiation enabled unless troubleshooting. Manual settings can cause mismatches.
concepts.code:
Default: speed auto, duplex auto
Manual: speed 100, duplex full
